prerequisites: Notions of Thermodynamics: power, energy, first and second principles
Basic notions concerning PDEs, solving ODEs

learning_outcomes.text: Understand the different modes of heat transfer.
Determine the power transferred in simple geometries in steady state.

syllabus_topics: Convection – dimensional analysis and correlation laws
Radiation – emissivity, linearized transfer between two surfaces
bibliography: JL Battaglia, Aj Kusiak, C Pradere, Introduction aux transferts thermiques : cours et exercices corrigés ; Dunod, 2020.
Michel Feidt, Énergétique : concepts et applications, cours et exercices corrigés ; Dunod, 2006.
degree: Licence Sciences pour l'Ingénieur - parcours Mécanique (L3)
